Prepare step by step

  1. Confirm the VIN and title information through official or organization sources.
  2. Separate seller statements from independent records and inspection findings.
  3. Read exclusions, limits, claim procedures and cancellation terms before relying on a warranty or service plan.
  4. Compare total cost and financing terms, not only the monthly payment.

General safety, records and service preparation only; no repair diagnosis, valuation, insurance coverage, legal or purchase recommendation.
